statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); let window := fun x p : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun n => p^100000 ≤ n^132301); let countHits := fun a x p : ℕ => ((window x p).filter (fun n => p ∣ n^2+a)).card; ∀ x q : ℕ, 0<q → |(countHits 1 x q : ℝ) - ((window x q).card : ℝ)*((roots 1 q).card : ℝ)/q| ≤ ((roots 1 q).card : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0017 · 将端点移动的整除误差控制在一个根系内
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0017 · Bound the endpoint error in the moving divisibility window

brief.zh: 幂阈值给出连续整数后缀。每个根余类的取整误差至多为一。
brief.en: The power cutoff selects a consecutive suffix. Each root class contributes at most one unit of rounding error.
